title: Model-specific soft-trip circuit breaker with tenanted fallback orchestration
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a model-aware, tenant-scoped 'soft-trip' circuit breaker that prevents cascading failures while preserving best-effort quality for affected requests. Unlike binary open/closed breakers, the soft-trip state will apply graduated mitigation (reduced concurrency, model downgrade, cached partials) and be driven by multi-signal thresholds: error-rate (5m rolling), p95 latency, and KV-cache-miss surge. Breakers must be addressable per-dependency (vector DB / sync service), per-model-variant, and per-tenant, with global coordination for multi-region failover. The system must: 1) minimize user-facing errors during infra incidents, 2) enforce SLOs by shedding work and degrading gracefully, and 3) be observable and testable via the Console.

Design highlights:
- Thresholds: rolling-window error-rate (default 3%) and p95 latency (adaptive: baseline +2x stddev). Allow per-tenant overrides via config in Control Plane.
- States: CLOSED -> SOFT_TRIPPED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN -> CLOSED. SOFT_TRIPPED reduces allowed concurrency by a configurable factor and enables fallback strategies instead of immediate failures.
- Fallback orchestration: prioritized sequence: 1) return from local KV/response cache (if within freshness TTL), 2) downgrade to a cheaper, lower-capacity model-variant with quality score guarantee, 3) serve truncated/partial structured responses with explanatory meta, 4) queue for async completion (for tenants with async enabled), 5) finally return 503 with deterministic retry-after when other mitigations unavailable.
- Storage & sync: breaker state stored in strongly-consistent Redis cluster for single-region; for multi-region, use region-local state with gossiped heartbeats and a control-plane arbitration layer to avoid split-brain during failover.
- Metrics & SLO mapping: expose per-breaker metrics (state, trips, trip-reason histogram, time-in-state), signal the SLO engine when degraded remains >3m. Integrate with Console to show tenant-level impact and to trigger runbook links.
- Safety: rate-limits for fallbacks to avoid amplifying load (e.g., model-downgrade cap), safe defaults for private deployments (no model-downgrade unless customer opts in), and auditable decision logs for every fallback.

Success criteria: demonstrable reduction in end-to-end user errors during simulated infra incidents, clear Console surfacing, and documented playbooks for on-call.
updates: 2025-11-13: Architecture sync with runtime and infra teams. Agreed to use Redis for fast state and control-plane for cross-region arbitration. Action: infra to provision a small HA Redis cluster in staging (ENG-11010).
2025-11-14: Design review with PM and Design. PM requested explicit tenant opt-out for model downgrade in dedicated/private. Added opt-out flag.

2025-11-15: Spike completed: implemented prototype soft-trip logic in the local request router and validated concurrency throttling. Prototype PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4012

2025-11-16: Load test planned against staged cluster simulating KV-cache failures and model slowdowns. Test harness updated; test plan attached to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/ENG-11456+soft-trip+test+plan

2025-11-18: Security review note: model-downgrade could expose IP/quality variance in Private deployments. Security requests explicit per-tenant consent and KMS-enforced policy for fallback artifacts. Marked security_review_required=true.
acceptance_criteria: Per-model and per-tenant breakers are configurable and persisted in control plane
SOFT_TRIPPED state reduces concurrency and enables at least two fallback strategies
Console shows real-time breaker state and impact per-tenant and per-model
Automated chaos test reduces end-user 5xx rates by >=40% during induced model slowdowns
Fallback decisions are logged with reason, chosen strategy, and policy that allowed it
notes: Implementation will reuse existing tokenized metrics pipeline; ensure tags for tenant_id, model_variant, region.
Fallthrough behavior must respect tenant capacity reservations on Dedicated clusters.
Follow-up work: automate rollback policy tied to runtime-1.22 (ENG-12000).
